home.subtitle: Guide
home.tagline: We are with you on your Hajj journey: tasks, guidance, and a multilingual interface.
home.body: After you complete your profile, you can follow tasks in your chosen language. With Arabic, the layout uses right-to-left text. New sections will be added through the same translation files as the app grows.

ihramAdimlar.title: Our steps
ihramAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Complete the required body cleaning.
ihramAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Put on the Ihram clothing.
ihramAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Pray 2 rak'ahs of the Ihram prayer.
ihramAdimlar.step7: 7. Step: Learn and observe the Ihram prohibitions

kudumAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Recite the supplication for entering al-Masjid al-Ḥarām
kudumAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Greet the Black Stone (Ḥajar al-Aswad) and intend the ṭawāf
kudumAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Perform seven circuits of ṭawāf around the Kaʿbah
kudumAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Greet the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamanī) each circuit
kudumAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Perform two rakʿas of ṭawāf prayer at Maqām Ibrāhīm

kudumAdim1Mescid.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim1Mescid.dua: Allāhumma anta al-salām wa minka al-salām, fa hayyinā Rabbanā bi al-salām
kudumAdim1Mescid.meaning: O Allah! You are As-Salām, and safety is from You. Keep us alive, our Lord, in safety (salvation).
kudumAdim1Mescid.note: 📍 Enter with the right foot at the gate of al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and recite this supplication.

kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.niyet: I intend to perform ṭawāf — O Allah, accept it from me.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.meaning: In the name of Allah — Allah is the Greatest.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note1: 📍 The Black Stone is at the eastern corner of the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note2: 🤲 If possible it is kissed; if crowded, greet it from a distance by raising the hand.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note3: ⚠️ Do it without harming anyone; no pushing or forcing.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note4: 🔄 At each circuit, when you reach the Black Stone, greet it again.

kudumAdim3Tavaf7.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.dua: Subḥān Allāhi wa al-ḥamdu lillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.yemaniHacerLabel: Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone:
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.yemaniHacer: Rabbanā ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāb al-nār
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note1: 🔄 Ṭawāf begins at the Black Stone, with the Kaʿbah on your left.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note2: 🕋 Walk outside the Ḥāṭim; do not go through the inside (the semi-circle).
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note3: 🚶 Men perform ramal (brisk, shoulder-rolling walk) in the first three rounds.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note4: 👆 In each round, touch the Yemeni Corner, and salute the Black Stone.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note5: 🚫 Do not recite the talbiyah while performing ṭawāf.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note6: 👩 Women do not raise their voices, and it is good to do ṭawāf in a less crowded area if possible.

kudumAdim4RuknYemani.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenLabel: Supplication between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone:
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenArabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenLatin: Rabbanā ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāb al-nār
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenMeaning: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note1: 📍 Rukn al-Yamanī is at the south-western corner of the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note2: 🤲 If possible, greet with the hand; it is not kissed.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note3: ↔️ Greeting from a distance is enough; you do not have to push or strain.

kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.ayetLabel: Verse to reflect on before the prayer:
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.ayetMeaning: And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Ibrāhīm a place of prayer. (Qurʾan 2:125)
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note1: 📍 If possible, pray behind Maqām Ibrāhīm.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note2: 👥 If crowded, the prayer may be offered anywhere in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note3: ⏰ It is not performed at the disliked (karāhah) times.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note4: 🤲 After the prayer, face the Kaʿbah and supplicate.

kudumAdim6Zemzem.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileLatin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka ʿilman nāfiʿan wa rizqan wāsiʿan wa shifā'an min kulli dā'
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileMeaning: O Allah! I ask You for beneficial knowledge, ample provision, and healing from every disease.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note1: 🕋 It is recommended standing, facing the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note2: 💧 Drink plenty, but do not waste.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note3: 🤲 Afterwards one makes a personal supplication; this is a very precious time.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note4: ✨ It is authentically reported that Zamzam is for whatever intention it is drunk for (hadith).

sayAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Go up to Safa and form the intention for saʿy
sayAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Face the Kaʿbah, say the takbīr, tahlīl, and supplicate
sayAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Walk from Safa toward Marwah (men may walk briskly at the green lights)
sayAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: At Marwah, turn toward the Kaʿbah and say the takbīr and supplicate
sayAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Continue until 7 rounds are complete (4 outward + 3 return legs)
sayAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: At Marwah, complete the supplication as appropriate

sayAdim1Safa.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim1Safa.ayetArabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
sayAdim1Safa.ayetMeaning: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. (Qurʾan 2:158)
sayAdim1Safa.niyet: O Allah! I intend to perform saʿy for Your sake. Make it easy for me and accept it from me.
sayAdim1Safa.note1: 📍 Saʿy begins at Ṣafā and ends at Marwah.
sayAdim1Safa.note2: 🕋 Open the hands, say the takbīr and tahlīl, while facing the Kaʿbah.
sayAdim1Safa.note3: 🔢 One round (shaṭṭ) is Ṣafā → Marwah; the next is Marwah → Ṣafā.
sayAdim1Safa.note4: 🏃 Men may run (harwalah) in the marked section; women walk normally.

ihramAdim1Temizlik.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim1Temizlik.male3: Trim hair and beard, shorten the mustache
ihramAdim1Temizlik.male4: Use pleasant scent (forbidden after entering Ihram)
ihramAdim1Temizlik.female3: Do not use makeup or perfume (forbidden in Ihram)
ihramAdim1Temizlik.female4: If menstruating, ghusl is still taken; you may do all rites except tawaf

ihramAdim2Gusl.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim2Gusl.line4: Take water in the mouth, rinse
ihramAdim2Gusl.line6: Wash the whole body (no dry spot left)
ihramAdim2Gusl.line7: Let water reach the roots of the hair

ihramAdim3Elbise.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim3Elbise.male2: One lower garment: the izar is worn wrapped from the waist down.
ihramAdim3Elbise.male3: The other: the rida is draped over the shoulders.
ihramAdim3Elbise.male5: On the feet: sandals or open footwear at the heels.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female1: Normal, clean, and modest clothes are worn.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female2: The dress should not show the body’s shape.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female4: The face and hands remain visible.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female5: Ornate accessories, perfume, and eye-catching dress are avoided.

ihramAdim4Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim4Namaz.line1: Face the qibla in a state of wudūʾ
ihramAdim4Namaz.line2: Intention: “I intend to perform the Ihram prayer”
ihramAdim4Namaz.line4: In the first rak'ah: al-Fātiḥah and al-Kāfirūn,
ihramAdim4Namaz.line5: in the second: al-Fātiḥah and al-Ikhlāṣ (recommended)

ihramAdim5Niyet.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim5Niyet.line1: O Allah! I intend to perform the Hajj for Your good pleasure. Make it easy for me and accept it from me.
ihramAdim5Niyet.line2: The intention is made in the heart; saying it aloud is sunnah.

ihramAdim6Telbiye.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim6Telbiye.reading: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayk lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna l-ḥamda wa n-niʿmata laka wa l-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
ihramAdim6Telbiye.meaning: Here I am, O Allah, here I am; here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise, grace, and the kingdom are Yours; You have no partner.

ihramAdim7Yasaklar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.title: 🚫 IHRĀM PROHIBITIONS
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.maleGiyim3: Wearing socks, gloves, or shoes that cover the heels
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.femaleGiyim1: Covering the face or wearing a face-veil
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.koku1: Using perfume, deodorant, or scented soap
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.kokuNote: (Unscented soap and cream may be used)
ihramAdim7Yasaklar.doga1: Plucking or cutting plants in the sacred precinct (ḥaram)
